messages:
ravi: Quick thread — need a compact, tenant-aware rollout metadata shape to avoid retry storms when pins are evicted.
nora: Can we aim for a tiny schema that encodes phase + operator hints? Suggest fields: `evict_phase`, `phase_expires_ms`, `router_backoff_ms`, `fallback_id`, `require_quality_gate`.
zack: Agree. semantics: `evict_phase` = none|soft|hard. soft = still serve but throttle, router responds 429 + `X-RW-Evict: soft`. hard = stop serving, return 503.
ravi: Router contract: when soft, include `Retry-After` computed from `router_backoff_ms`. SDKs should honor but also use jittered exponential backoff capped by `max_retries` from tenant config.
nora: Add `tenant_multiplier` so ops can extend windows for VIP tenants. Also a `reconcile_hint_ms` telling reconciliation job when to escalate.
zack: Telemetry: emit `rollout.eviction.{phase}` events with tags (tenant, model, rollout_id, controller_version). Add a reconciliation alarm when soft exceeds 2x `phase_expires_ms`.
infra-bot: note: controller v2.2 will add `evict_phase` but keep it optional until migration. Feature-flag rollout-evict-v2 created.
ravi: Edge case: fallback quality mismatch. Add `fallback_quality_tier` and `allow_fail_open` to metadata; if `require_quality_gate=true` and compat low, router must not auto-fallback.
nora: Minimal example JSON we can land in PR: `{"evict_phase":"soft","phase_expires_ms":30000,"router_backoff_ms":200,"fallback_id":"model-lite-v1","require_quality_gate":false}`
zack: Migration plan: 1) schema add optional fields. 2) Controller flag off. 3) Canary on a few tenants for 48h. 4) Flip on. Note: old clients ignore unknown headers.
ravi: OK, I'll open the RFC with flows and the SDK guidance. Can we meet 15m tomorrow to assign owners?
nora: yep.
infra-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled 09:30 UTC tomorrow for rollout-evict sync.
